name: @bbthorson/pinakes
description: Fictional continuity linter and AT Protocol record compiler

scripts.build: tsc && node -e "import('fs').then(fs => { fs.cpSync('../template', './dist/template', { recursive: true }); fs.rmSync('./dist/template/.git', { recursive: true, force: true }); })" && node scripts/sync-readme.mjs
scripts.test: npm run build && tsc -p test && node --experimental-strip-types --test 'test/**/*.test.ts'
